key_insight: The paper formalizes a Lean 4 certification framework for proving key arithmetic invariants of number fields, extending verified computation from rings of integers to discriminants, signatures, unit groups modulo p-th powers, and class groups.
engineering_relevance: It provides a pathway for trustworthy computer algebra pipelines by turning high-level number-theoretic computations into machine-checked proofs, which is valuable for CAS, databases, and verified symbolic computation.
method: Build reusable Lean 4 structures for certified arithmetic on algebraic objects, including ideal arithmetic.
Extend certification to invariants such as signature, unit groups modulo p-th powers, class group, and improved discriminant verification.
Use a SageMath script to compute certificates and generate Lean proofs automatically.
evidence_signal: The framework was used to verify hundreds of LMFDB entries covering discriminant, signature, class number, and class group structure.
watch_item: Certificate generation depends on external SageMath computations and careful translation into Lean proofs, so automation and scalability may still be sensitive to implementation details.
